delivery.text: Actual transaction and spent output evidence flows through the existing observer into the comparator. The fixed Lean driver independently supplies expectations. One implementer repairs the code while a separate reviewer checks committed milestones.

boundary.text: Keep the repair in the existing live observation modules and their tests. Do not move modules or edit offchain, validators, Lean, shared configuration, or generated books.

verification-limits.text: Run existing tests and connected devnet cases. A fixture demonstrates observation behavior, not live validator acceptance.
